overall: MARGINAL this afternoon, GOOD again from ~6 PM through Mon 19
limiterDetail: Main limiter: a combination. Rain in the north and west ~3–5 PM (about 1.2–1.4 mm/h), current at Tara and Turda (1.0–1.5 kt all evening), and wind in the south (Nangalao up to 16.2 kt ~8 PM; Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 12.4–14.2 kt ~4 PM to midnight). Wind in Coron, Culion and Galoc stays under 2.2 kt until Mon 6 AM. ECMWF still rates Sun 18 GOOD for the day (4.2 kt, gusts 11, ~6.1 mm).

changed.title: ℹ️ What changed since this morning
items: No material change to the supply outlook. ECMWF still has Sun 18 and Mon 19 GOOD (Mon is the best day: 4.5 kt, gusts 12, ~5.5 mm) and Tue 20 to Sat 24 MARGINAL , with the worst day still Thu 22 (12 kt, current 0.8 kt) and heavy rain still on Sat 24 (~18.4 mm). Shortage risk stays ELEVATED and the surge flag stays OFF.

This afternoon's snapshot is weaker: 4 of 14 grounds are GOOD (7 this morning), 8 MARGINAL and 2 POOR. That's mostly short-term: showers ~3–5 PM drop Coron, Culion, Galoc, Alava and Binudac to MARGINAL even though the wind is almost calm, and the tide pushes Tara (1.2 kt) and Turda (1.0 kt) into POOR on current. The south flipped the other way: Cabunlawan and Decabaitot are GOOD right now (9.3 kt). GFS shows more rain than ECMWF right now (4.3 vs 0.5 mm), so shower timing is less certain.

bestWindow.headline: ~6 PM tonight to Mon noon (Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay)
details: ~6 PM to midnight: Coron, Culion and Galoc have 1.0–1.6 kt wind, 0.2–0.4 kt current and almost no rain once the showers clear. Maglalambay has 1.2–4.2 kt and 0.1–0.3 kt current.

Mon ~3 AM to noon: the same grounds stay under 4.5 kt with 0.0–0.2 kt current and only light drizzle (0.2 mm/h). The model's best hour is ~Mon 4 AM at Culion and Galoc. Alava and Binudac are good from ~midnight to Mon 6 AM (under 3.1 kt, current 0.1–0.3), and Decabobo from Mon ~2 AM to 11 AM (current 0.1–0.3).

Expect a short drizzle break ~midnight–2 AM in the north (0.7 mm/h). Keep boats off Nangalao for the full 24h and off Cabunlawan and Decabaitot until Mon ~2 AM. Ciron is workable from ~9 PM (under 10 kt, current 0.0–0.2). Tara and Turda are best around Mon 5–9 AM, but current still runs 0.8 kt there.
